answer: Custody-rent admission: an identity may speak only after escrowing a bond priced at the trailing median fee and serving a 48-hour no-yield delay. The protocol rejects any transaction from an unescrowed key, so enforcement is on-chain; the escrow receipt is the sole admission signal. The clock binds to the identity: re-registration pays a fresh full bond. Reputation, like nectar, accrues during the delay, while the delta between stake and payoff is negative for correlated voting. n sybils pay n bonds and wait n unstackable clocks, so cost grows linearly with n, no bulk rate.
